name: Skrapp
summary: Work email finding and verification, phone lookup, and company search, snapshots and enrichment.

api_key.description: A Skrapp API key (skrapp.io account > API). Sent in the X-Access-Key header.

notes: Email search, verification, company enrich and phone lookup spend credits; account, company search and snapshot are free.
Company calls return X-RateLimit-* headers, and a 429 carries Retry-After.
Bulk email search, bulk phone and bulk company enrich, and list management are not in this entry.

endpoints.name: Get account and credits
endpoints.summary: Credit quota and usage (credit.email) and the 50 most recent lists.
notes: Free. Remaining credits are credit.email.quota minus credit.email.used.

endpoints.name: Find a work email
endpoints.summary: A person's business email from their name and company, checked for deliverability.

fullName.description: Full name, instead of firstName and lastName; wins when both are sent.

domain.description: Company domain; a URL is reduced to its domain. Wins over company.

company.description: Company name, used when no domain is given.

linkedinUrl.description: The person's LinkedIn profile URL, to pin the person.

companyId.description: The company's LinkedIn id (digits); helps but does not replace domain or company.

country.description: Country name or ISO alpha-2; picks the country email domain of large companies.

includeCompanyData.description: Exactly true to add companyData, at no extra cost.

waitVerifier.description: true (default): verify before answering, so quality.status is final.

notes: 1 credit per email found for the first time; not found is free, and invalid or unknown results are refunded on paid plans.
Send a name (firstName + lastName, or fullName) and a company (domain or company). Times out after 10 seconds with 408, uncharged.
Free plans: 150 searches per user and per IP a day; paid plans are unlimited while more than 10% of credits remain.

endpoints.name: Find a person's phone numbers
endpoints.summary: Mobile, direct or company numbers from a LinkedIn profile, or a name with a company or country.

linkedinUrl.description: LinkedIn profile URL, slug or Sales Navigator id; enough alone.

fullName.description: Full name, instead of first and last.

companyDomain.description: The person's company domain; tried before companyName.

country.description: ISO alpha-2 country; narrows a name-only search, or ranks numbers from it first.

notes: 5 credits per person number found, 1 when only company numbers come back; not found is free. The charge is in cost.
Check confidence (high, medium, low) on name-based matches before using a number.

endpoints.name: Search companies
endpoints.summary: Companies by keywords, firmographics, location, size, revenue and more, paginated.

start.description: Offset, a multiple of size; below 100 on free plans, 1,000 on paid.

size.description: Page size, 1-100 (free plans at most 20), default 20.

lead_counts.description: Add lead_count per company (default true); false is faster.

keywords.description: 1-10 terms matched in the description and tags.

companyTypes.description: Public Company, Privately Held, Subsidiary, Non-Profit, ...

notes: A read over POST: the filters go in the body. Free: no credits.
Free plans 20 calls a minute and 50 a day, paid 100 and 2,000. Funding, hiring, technology, growth and similar premium filters need a paid plan or the 14-day trial, else 403.
Pass a result's internal_id (not its id) to company.snapshot and company.enrich.

endpoints.name: Get a company card
endpoints.summary: Name, website, industry, size, revenue range, headquarters and founding year of one company.

id.description: Internal company id (a search result's internal_id, kept as a string), not the encoded id.

name.description: Company name; the most popular match wins, so prefer domain or id.

notes: Free. Send exactly one of id, domain or name. Free plans 500 distinct companies a day, paid 5,000; repeat views the same day are free.

endpoints.name: Enrich a company
endpoints.summary: Detailed company data in chosen categories: firmographics, headcount, financials, funding, hiring, technographics, traffic and more.

id.description: Internal company id (a search result's internal_id, kept as a string), not the encoded id.

name.description: Company name; the most popular match wins, so prefer domain or id.

categories.description: Comma-separated keys: signals, headcount, financials, hiring, funding, technographics, acquisitions, firmographics, competitors, social, traffic, contacts; omit or all for every one.

notes: 1-5 credits per category the first time your account enriches it for that company (all 12 cost 25); repeats are free. total_cost gives the charge.
Send exactly one of id, domain or name. 402 when credits are short, 404 when no company matches; neither is charged.

endpoints.name: Verify an email
endpoints.summary: Deliverability status of one email address.

enrich.description: true adds companyData for professional addresses, at no extra cost.

notes: 1 credit per email, free if your account already verified or found it; a malformed address is answered invalid and still charged. The charge is in consumedCredit.
Free plans 100 checks per IP a day.

endpoints.name: Verify several emails
endpoints.summary: Deliverability status of 2 to 50 addresses in one synchronous call.

email.description: 2 to 50 addresses, sent as repeated email parameters.

notes: 1 credit per email; the balance must cover them all. Match results by email, not position: a failed address can be missing.
